note: Twenty-two measured regions, twenty-two accounted: twenty-two figure items, no counted tables and no exclusions. All twenty-two printed figure numbers attach one-to-one to a measured region. Declared gap: 'Table 1: Parameters' is printed on p5 and the geometry pass measures no block on that page, so it is recorded here and not counted. Section paths use the numbered headings only; the plot-title lines that context_extract reports as headings ('18 Time Optimization (DX = 6 y = 100)', '80 Minimum Nights for Slow Boat (DX = 6 y = 100)', '100 Campsite mu (Y=100, DX = 6)') are in-plot titles and are not used.
rules: Every one of the twenty-two regions carries a printed 'Figure N:' caption, so the items and the numbers pair one-to-one and the paper contributes no table rows [caption.verbatim].
Figures 1-7 and 9-15 are unconnected marker clouds - most with short capped error bars - on printed tick frames, so they are scatter and not line or bar [geometry.family].
Figure 8 is the one bar chart in the paper: a single solid bar per campsite on a common zero baseline [geometry.family].
Figure 16 is drawn art with no axes, no tick numbers and no plotted values, so it is flowchart-or-schematic and printed_numbers is false [geometry.printed_numbers].
The six appendix panels are the only figures with an in-plot legend, boxed inside the frame and keyed to P(fast) [geometry.legend].
The appendix panels carry printed tick numbers but their axis titles sit inside the plot as prose, so data_labels records the parameter note box [geometry.data_labels].
Ten figures are cited in running text within one page of the exhibit: 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10 and 15 from the page before, 13 and 14 from the page after, and 16 on its own page [mention.lead_sentence].
Figures 11 and 12 are introduced on p18 but printed two pages later on p20, so no mention row is recorded for them [mention.first_page].

Caption text is cut out of the page text between the 'Figure N:' label and the next token on the page, because the plotting package leaves in-plot titles and tick numbers in the same text run [caption.verbatim].
